description.value: Mandarin Garden Buffet has been a Chilliwack-area institution since 1998, serving a wide-ranging Chinese smorgasbord buffet alongside a full take-out menu six days a week. It has earned the Chilliwack Times Reader's Choice award for Favourite Buffet, drawing diners from Chilliwack, Abbotsford, and Agassiz. A large private banquet room rounds out the offering for groups and special occasions.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and supplies address and phone absent from OSM; the contact page explicitly lists 'WiFi Access,' and the front page confirms dine-in and take-out. No bike parking, washroom, or water-refill information appears anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, actively operating Chinese buffet restaurant with a live website showing updated 2024 pricing and a confirmed physical address in Chilliwack.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM record has no address or phone; both have been sourced from the business website. OSM community is listed as 'Sardis,' which is a neighbourhood within the City of Chilliwack — consistent with the website address on Luckakuck Way.

wow_evidence: earned the Chilliwack Times Reader's Choice award for Favourite Buffet
